summary: Verifact BackOffice env routing + Registration overhaul: comprehensive backend and frontend testing. All critical flows pass.

minor.issue: When no X-Verifact-Env header is sent, backend defaults to VERIFACT_API_URL env var which is currently 'https://ecf-test.api.verifact.com.do' (TEST). Spec implies the default should be PROD. Non-blocking since the frontend ALWAYS sends the header. Consider changing default in backend/.env or in get_current_verifact_url() fallback to 'prod'.

backend_tests.test_login_fails_on_prod_env: PASS - returns success:false (account does not exist in PROD)
backend_tests.test_login_no_header_uses_backend_defaul: PASS - documents that backend default routes to TEST currently

frontend_tests.T9_RNC_onBlur_calls_api_rnc_consultar_wi: PASS - shows 'RNC no encontrado en la DGII...' warning, companyName stays empty
frontend_tests.T11_register_submit_hits_api_tenant_regi: PASS - call captured with X-Verifact-Env=test header; registration succeeded (redirect to /login with 'Registro exitoso' success message)

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: Reconsider the backend fallback when no X-Verifact-Env header is provided. Currently it defaults to whatever VERIFACT_API_URL env var is set to (TEST). The product spec states default should be 'Producción'. The frontend always sends the header so user-facing behavior is correct, but to be safe set VERIFACT_API_URL=https://ecf.api.verifact.com.do in backend/.env or change fallback in get_verifact_url().
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1710 lines — exceeds the 700-line threshold from review guidelines. Recommend splitting per-resource proxy routes (auth, clientes, sucursales, facturas, ecf, rnc, comprobantes, certificados) into separate routers under /app/backend/routers/.
Backend uses httpx.AsyncClient(verify=False, ...) for all proxy calls — acceptable for self-signed DGII certs but should be documented as intentional.

Frontend AuthContext lookupRnc() success detection compares free-form strings ('No encontrado', 'Error', 'Error al consultar') — fragile. Prefer checking a structured field like data.status === 'ACTIVO' to determine validity.
seed_data_creation: Test user 'test_user_e2e@example.com' / company TEST_Empresa SRL was registered via the registration flow in the TEST environment as part of T11. Backend returned success.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Environment selector + X-Verifact-Env header propagation works end-to-end. Login on TEST env succeeds, fails on PROD/CERT as expected. Register page has RNC first, with both onBlur and onKeyDown=Enter triggering the lookup, plus an explicit Consultar button. Tenant submit hits /api/tenant/registrar with the env header. Header env badge reflects selected env after login. No outstanding bugs. Only minor consideration: backend default env (when no header) is TEST not PROD, but irrelevant to UI flow.
